text:
maya: heads up — CI just failed on audit-event-validator after yesterday's RBAC cleanup + KMS key rotation. golden fixtures mismatch on customer.audit.login events :confused:

audit-bot: CI failed: audit-validator (release/ci) — 3 tests failed, run 2169001234. See logs: https://ci.internal/runs/2169001234 :warning:

sam: pushing logs now. error looks like schema mismatch (`principal_id` moved from object to string?)

kevin: hmm, we did that RBAC flattening last night. I thought the transformer also updated audit-events generator. Could be a producer drift in dedicated-hosting telemetry.

lina: copying the validator error snippet — from the CI log:
```
ValidationError: event.customer.audit.login: required property 'principal.id' is missing
   at validate (/app/validator/index.js:142)
   at Object.validateEvent (/app/validator/index.js:56)
   meta: { expected: 'object', received: 'string' }
```

maya: the golden fixture for that event still has `principal: { id: ..., role: ... }` while new producers emit `principal: "user:123"`. That explains the mismatch. But why didn't schema migration run?

sam: CI uses golden fixtures baked into repo. There was a migration PR from kevin that updated transformer but not the golden fixture generator. I see a PR branch: https://git.internal/r/infra/audit-fixtures/merge_requests/42

kevin: ack. I updated producer but forgot to run `scripts/generate-goldens --refresh`. My bad. Two questions: 1) Do we treat this as a validator regression (blocker) or fixture drift? 2) Is KMS rotation implicated?

opsbot: deploy-bot: KMS key rotation completed at 2024-11-02T03:10:00Z for project redwood-prod. No consumer errors recorded by key-usage-alerts.

lina: rotation likely unrelated; validator fails on shape, not signature. But KMS could have caused some producers to fallback to legacy code path temporarily which might emit old shape — need to confirm producer version across fleet.

maya: plan: revert CI gating (unblock merges) -> create short-lived canary CI that runs full audit-schema compatibility checks -> refresh goldens and add schema-guided unit test. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

kevin: sounds good. I'll open a PR to refresh goldens + add a lint check that fails if any event generator changed shape without bumping a `golden_version` tag. Also add a simple script to diff sample events: `tools/audit/diff_golden.py`

sam: for immediate unblock I can patch CI to treat this failure as 'warning' for one run (we keep a record). But we should not ship to prod without validating customer-facing audit events. Maybe add a smoke test that replays a small set of golden events through the new validator (local-mode) before PR merge.

security-oncall: agree with conservative approach. Also request: log the validator error with structured metadata (producer version, commit, k8s node id, kms key id) so we can correlate with rotation windows. Add that as an instrumentation task for the validator service.

maya: assigning tasks -> kevin: PR to refresh goldens + add golden_version enforcement; sam: CI patch to mark as advisory temporarily; lina: run fleet producer version sweep and post results; kevin/sam: coordinate to add structured error fields. I'll own the follow-up and the rollback policy doc for audit-schema incidents.

kevin: started PR draft: https://git.internal/r/infra/audit-fixtures/merge_requests/43 - includes golden refresh, unit + diff script. Will tag reviewers. :hammer:

sam: CI patched in emergency branch `ci/audit-softfail-2169`. Will run and report results.

lina: fleet check shows 97% producers at v2.14 (new shape), 3% at v2.13 (old nested principal). I'll file a remediation ticket to roll those to v2.14.

maya: great, please summarize findings in the incident slack thread when ready. If we see overlap with KMS rotation window, include key ids.

audit-bot: NOTE: recording incident 2169-audit-schema-drift in PSIRT board. Triage status: investigating.

sam: running the smoke replay now (`tools/audit/replay --count 20 --mode local`). will paste results shortly. :running_shirt_with_sash:

[thread resolved after golden refresh + fleet roll to v2.14; CI gating reinstated with additional checks — follow-up ticket created: INFRA-8421]
